title: Simple Machines
subtitle: Workshop manual
text:
Powered machines built by hand. Every machine starts as a chassis; you fit its parts one at a time and fix each with a screwdriver.

Start with an Alloy Furnace and an Extruder, which burn fuel. They make the steel, redstone copper and rods everything else needs.
